column1: # wq#899 PR backlog reconciliation — the decision record for every open PR whose ticket is done.
# Actions: close = comment the note then close; land = merged via lumen-pr; reopen = ticket reopened.
# Evidence for each row comes from ops/wq899-pr-recon/scan.json (forge state + git ancestry +
# ticket status + which PR the ticket's own notes cite). Re-run pr_recon.py to re-derive it.
# --- landed under wq#899: real unmerged work, merged cleanly, recorded here for the trail --
# foreman #80 #112 #86 #98 #91 #107 #101 #102 #52 and minerva #7 were squash-merged via
# lumen-pr. #80 was the urgent one: wq#825's dispatcher_health lived only in a working tree.
# --- still open on purpose: conflicts with main, so the TICKET reopens instead -------------
# A rebase needs a force-push, which this lane is not permitted to do, so the honest outcome
# is to stop claiming the ticket is done and let a lane rebase and land it.
